description: This file defines the 'Subunit' entity class, which maps to a database table 'ohrm_subunit'. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping and implements a nested set model interface for hierarchical data management within an HRM system.

classes.name: Subunit
classes.description: Entity class representing a organizational subunit with nested set hierarchy capabilities, including properties like id, name, description, and nested set indices.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the subunit.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the subunit.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the subunit.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the subunit.

methods.name: getUnitId
methods.description: Retrieves the unit identifier, if any.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the subunit.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description for the subunit.

methods.name: getLft
methods.description: Gets the left boundary index in the nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: setLft
methods.description: Sets the left boundary index in the nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: getRgt
methods.description: Gets the right boundary index in the nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: setRgt
methods.description: Sets the right boundary index in the nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the level of the node in the hierarchy.

methods.name: setLevel
methods.description: Sets the node's level in the hierarchy.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Retrieves the node object associated with this subunit, initializing it if null.

methods.name: setNode
methods.description: Assigns a node object to this subunit.
